body:
Research findings for #2769 (from FANUC MANUAL GUIDE *i* `B-63874EN` / `B-63874EN-2` and our codebase):

### 1. Answers to open questions

1. **`G1902` (rectangular block) addresses and signs**
   - `B`: width along X (positive value).
   - `D`: depth along Y (positive value).
   - `H`: height along Z (positive value).
   - `I`: `WORK ORIGIN X`, distance along X from the lower-left corner (`min X`) to the work origin (`OriginX - StockXYLeft`).
   - `J`: `WORK ORIGIN Y`, distance along Y from the lower-left corner (`min Y`) to the work origin (`OriginY - StockXYFront`).
   - `K`: `WORK ORIGIN Z`, distance along Z from the lower-left corner (`min Z`) to the work origin (`OriginZ - StockZBottom`).
   - `I`, `J`, and `K` accept positive, zero, or negative values.
   - Check against the issue example (100 x 60 x 30 block, `G54` at top center): `I=50.`, `J=30.`, `K=30.` gives `G1902 B100. D60. H30. I50. J30. K30.`.
   - Each length word must include a decimal point (`fu(...)` in `assets/posts/fanuc.cps`). Fanuc parameter `3401#0` (`DPI=0`) reads numbers without decimal points in least increments.

2. **`G1900` and `G1906` (round bar / column) addresses, bar length, and axis position**
   - `G1900` defines a solid cylinder along Z.
   - `G1906` defines a solid cylinder along X on machining centers that set X-axis work rotation parameters `14717` and `27003`.
   - Both codes use `D` (diameter, positive) and `L` (length, positive), not `H`.
   - `K` is `WORK ORIGIN Z`, the distance along the bar axis from the front end face to the work origin (cutting allowance).
   - `G1900` does not take `I` or `J` offsets in `B-63874EN`. It puts the cylinder axis on the work origin axis.
   - `G1900` and `G1906` cannot represent an off-center cylinder (`OriginX`/`OriginY` off the Z-bar centerline, or `OriginY`/`OriginZ` off the X-bar centerline). Write a comment instead of a wrong block.
   - Open check for the Robodrill kit test: confirm whether `G1900` in milling animation reads `K` from the top face (`StockZTop - OriginZ`) or from the bottom face (`OriginZ - StockZBottom`).

3. **Where the block must stand in the program**
   - Put the blank block after the `O`-word, header comments, and `G20`/`G21`.
   - Put the blank block before `G90`, `G54`..`G59`, `T.. M6`, and the first motion.
   - In `crates/post/src/post/engine.rs`, `onOpen` runs before any `Record::Param` arrives. `StockXY*`, `StockZTop`, and `Origin*` are not set in `onOpen`.
   - `startPreamble()` in `assets/posts/fanuc.cps` runs after `onParameter` delivers those values. Write the blank block once at the start of the first `startPreamble()`, before `opNotes()` and `G90`. That places it right after `G20`/`G21` and before `G90`, `G54`, and `T.. M6`.

4. **Animation mode and `AUTO`/`MEM` mode**
   - Manual Guide *i* simulation and animation read `G1900`, `G1902`, and `G1906` to draw the stock blank.
   - In `AUTO` or `MEM` mode on a control with Manual Guide *i*, the control skips blank-definition blocks and cuts from standard ISO blocks.
   - On a Fanuc control without Manual Guide *i*, `G1902` can raise an alarm. Keep the post option off by default.

5. **Inch behaviour (`G20`)**
   - When `postOptions.Units === "inch"`, `fu(...)` in `assets/posts/fanuc.cps` divides lengths by `25.4` and formats 4 decimals with a trailing point.
   - Important `B-63874EN` limit: Manual Guide *i* ignores `G20` and `G21` during background simulation. It reads blank dimensions in the control's configured input unit parameter (`mm` or `inch`). Note this limit in the option description and kit guide.

---

### 2. Design proposal (smallest useful first slice first)

#### Codebase gaps today
- `crates/post/src/post/mod.rs` (`Dump`, `dump`) and `crates/app/src/posting.rs` (`op_streams_by`) write `StockXYLeft`, `StockXYRight`, `StockXYFront`, `StockXYBack`, and `StockZTop`. They do not write `StockZBottom` (`a.min.z` from `model::stock_world_aabb_for`).
- `op_streams_by` flattens `StockShape::Box`, `StockShape::Cylinder`, `StockShape::FromModel`, and missing stock into one bounding box. `assets/posts/fanuc.cps` cannot tell a box from a cylinder or an unsupported stock.
- `crates/app/tests/recorded_post_streams.rs` checks `post::dump` with `Dump::default()` against recorded `.cnc` files. New fields on `Dump` must be optional and default to `None`.

#### Proposed architecture
1. **Stream contract (`crates/post` and `crates/app`)**
   - Add optional fields to `post::Dump`: `stock_z_bottom: Option<f64>`, `stock_shape: Option<&'a str>`, `stock_diameter: Option<f64>`, and `stock_blank_reason: Option<&'a str>`.
   - Default all four fields to `None` in `Dump::default()` so all recorded `.cnc` streams stay byte-identical.
   - Populate them in `crates/app/src/posting.rs` (`op_streams_by`) from `setup::stock_entity`, `model::stock_def_of`, `model::transform_of`, `model::stock_world_aabb_for`, `stock_follow::is_square`, and `setup_stock::effective`.
   - Map stock states to `StockShape` values `"box"`, `"cylinder-z"`, `"cylinder-x"`, or `"unsupported"` with `StockBlankReason` (`"none"`, `"from-model"`, `"oblique"`, `"cylinder-y"`, or `"from-previous"`).
   - Keep those new parameters invariant in `crates/post/src/post/invert.rs` (used by both `invert` and `crates/post/src/post/wcs_flip.rs`). `invert.rs` already swaps and negates `StockXY*` and `OriginX`/`OriginY`, so `B`, `D`, `I`, `J`, and cylinder centers stay correct.
2. **Smallest useful first slice (`assets/posts/fanuc.cps`)**
   - Add `writeManualGuideBlank` (`type: "boolean"`, `default: false`, group `"Header & comments"`) to `declaredOptions` in `assets/posts/fanuc.cps`.
   - `declaredOptions` exposes the option in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_script_options.rs`, `crates/app/src/mcp/post_options_tools.rs` (`get_post_options`, `set_post_options`), CLI `--post-option`, and per-setup persistence with no schema or UI changes.
   - Keep default `false` so existing goldens (`crates/post/tests/fanuc_post.rs`, `crates/app/tests/conformance.rs`) stay byte-identical.
   - When `writeManualGuideBlank` is `true`, emit once at the start of the first `startPreamble()`:
     - Emit `G1902 B.. D.. H.. I.. J.. K..` for `"box"`.
     - Emit `G1900 D.. L.. K..` for centered `"cylinder-z"`.
     - Emit no block and write one comment explaining why when `StockShape` or `StockZBottom` is absent (legacy stream), stock is unsupported, `|wcsYaw| > 1e-6`, extents are non-positive, or a cylinder axis is off-center from the WCS origin.
   - Post one short `.nc` test kit for `vilts` to verify `G1902` and `G1900` on his Robodrill.
3. **Follow-up slice (`G1906` and Robodrill confirmation)**
   - After `vilts` confirms `G1902` and `G1900` (including the `G1900` `K` sign) on the Robodrill, add `G1906` for centered `"cylinder-x"` and adjust `K` if needed.

---

### 3. Proposed sub-issues

1. **Title:** `post: add optional stock shape, bottom Z, and diameter parameters to Dump and .cnc stream`
   - Adds optional `StockZBottom`, `StockShape`, `StockDiameter`, and `StockBlankReason` parameters in `crates/post/src/post/mod.rs`, `crates/post/src/post/invert.rs`, and `crates/app/src/posting.rs`.
   - **Done means:** `posting::stream_records` emits `StockZBottom`, `StockShape`, `StockDiameter`, and `StockBlankReason` for box, cylinder, and unsupported stocks; `invert.rs` and `wcs_flip.rs` keep them valid; `recorded_post_streams` passes unchanged.
   - **Proposed priority:** `P6`
   - **Proposed effort:** `effort:high` (touches `crates/post` and `crates/app` stream and inversion logic)
   - **Area:** `area:post`

2. **Title:** `fanuc.cps: add opt-in writeManualGuideBlank option for G1902 box and G1900 Z-cylinder blanks`
   - Adds the off-by-default `writeManualGuideBlank` option to `assets/posts/fanuc.cps` to emit `G1902` for box stock, `G1900` for centered Z-axis cylinders, or a comment for unsupported cases.
   - **Done means:** `fanuc.cps` passes existing goldens unchanged when the option is off; golden tests pin `G1902` (metric, inch, offset origin, inverted axis), `G1900`, and comments for `FromModel`, yawed WCS, off-center cylinders, and missing stock; one short test `.nc` kit is ready for Robodrill verification.
   - **Proposed priority:** `P6`
   - **Proposed effort:** `effort:high` (safety floor: changes posted G-code in `assets/posts/fanuc.cps`)
   - **Area:** `area:post`

3. **Title:** `fanuc.cps: add G1906 X-cylinder blank after Robodrill kit verification`
   - Extends `writeManualGuideBlank` in `assets/posts/fanuc.cps` to emit `G1906` for centered X-axis cylinders and applies any `G1900` `K`-origin correction from the Robodrill kit test.
   - **Done means:** `vilts` confirms in Manual Guide *i* simulation that the drawn blank matches the stock, `G1906` posts for centered X-axis cylinders with golden tests, and off-center X-axis cylinders post a comment instead of a block.
   - **Proposed priority:** `P6`
   - **Proposed effort:** `effort:high` (safety floor: changes posted G-code in `assets/posts/fanuc.cps`)
   - **Area:** `area:post`
